commander_identity.mechanical_plan: The Valeyard makes each opponent face every actual villainous choice an additional time and gives its controller a second real vote. Multiply the commander and vote spells, not generic political 'choose' text.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized. Current live Scryfall flags eight Game Changers, but this is a five-mana choice-based commander and opponent-selectable outcomes; no cEDH consistency is asserted.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Preserve all thirteen actual villainous-choice sources and eighteen Grixis voting support cards, including three Path spells. New Valeyard copy and Double Vision repeat those unique mechanics, with no unrelated Oracle/Breach combo package.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 physical library slots reconciled with exact October 15 canonical source, the M6 whole-list review and current Oracle. Six selected cuts and 93 retained slots documented in 99-slot CSV, with separate assessments of voting, choice, clone, tempo, counters and lands.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Exactly 36 lands retained. Haunted Ridge BR replaced with colorless Ancient Tomb, while two-mana Izzet Signet is replaced with conditional Chrome Mox imprint mana. Faster Valeyard deployment has a real extra color-pip risk; other multicolor rocks, duals and fetches remain.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Mana Drain, Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Deadly Rollick, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp and Feed the Swarm remain. Swan Song protects for one blue but cannot counter creatures or artifacts; Toxic Deluge loses Blasphemous Act one-red mode while handling indestructible toughness.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: All eighteen possible eligible Grixis real-vote cards are already in the source; thirteen native villainous choice sources and four commander-copy mechanisms define its identity. M6 KEEP was rational against generic combo proposals, but did not exhaust off-ranking direct commander-copy candidates.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: Reviewed thirty M6 screened exact add/cut pairs over eighteen unique adds, existing EDHREC inclusion/high-lift, live Scryfall 19-result vote-text Grixis search including The Valeyard, and eighteen new or newly challenged material replacements.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: OFF-RANKING Irenicus's Vile Duplication and Double Vision provide direct copy and actual vote-event replication. Chandra/Kitten/Helm/Resonator are valid but lose more voting density or require fragile extra setup at their proposed cuts.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: OFF-RANKING Valeyard-specific clone, Double Vision, spell-copy support, true vote search, enchantment protection and fast-mana challenger pool reviewed after M6 left the old list intact.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected six-swap exact 100/36 land portfolio with zero native vote/choice-source cuts.
Seven-swap full 100 adds Mana Vault at expense of Fellwar Stone; colorless acceleration costs repeatable Grixis color fixing.
Eight-swap full 100 adds Helm for the Shuttle; high equipment cost and one fewer villainous choice are unacceptable.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: The Master is not cut because Missy's face-down Cybermen creature cards are nontoken artifacts that enable its death-triggered choices. Cutting any of the three Path spells reduces the already exhausted true-vote pool. Shuttle is retained against expensive Helm.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: M6 correctly rejected broad Grixis combo homogenization but overlooked an extra permanent legal Valeyard copy and a recurring method to copy actual voting spell resolutions.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Current Oracle search confirms that the source has all eighteen actual vote support cards. Six carefully paid swaps materially advance repeat vote/choice gameplay; larger seven/eight-swap configurations have been staged and rejected for real role loss.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After six swaps, every retained physical library card was rechecked against the full M6 99-card role audit and the fresh Oracle records, including Fellwar Stone, Midnight Crusader Shuttle, Dark Ritual, the three voting Paths, the Master/Missy combo, Kess's role transfer to Double Vision and all early tapped colored lands. No five-swap target dictated the stopping point.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Mana Vault provides three generic burst to help Valeyard, but replacing Fellwar removes repeatable actual U, B or R in a deck with three required commander color pips and colored votes.
Helm creates another Valeyard only after four mana to cast plus five equip and survival to combat, while losing one of thirteen direct villainous choice sources when it replaces Shuttle.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Mana Vault provides a burst of colorless mana for the expensive commander and cloned voting engine in a hand with UBR colors already supplied.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Fellwar Stone provides repeated missing colors on the following turns; Mana Vault cannot cast an isolated U/B/R vote pip and demands an expensive untap cost.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Helm offers repeated nonlegendary Valeyard tokens each combat, an eventually massive pile of additive villainous-choice modifiers.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Its nine-mana casting/equipping burden requires survival to combat and removes the Shuttle's irreplaceable intrinsic villainous choice source from the deck.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The selected count follows a review of two larger legal 100-card packages, not an arbitrary numerical floor. Extra colorless acceleration degrades sustained UBR pips; further Helm cloning costs nine mana and deletes a unique villainous choice. Cutting voting Path spells removes real votes, and generic Breach/Oracle finishes would erase commander identity. No larger tested package improved the realistic whole deck.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: October 15 source exact raw unchanged. All four staged decks have 100 physical cards and 96 distinct names with only 2 Island, 2 Mountain and 3 Swamp repeats. Final six balanced one-for-one replacements maintain 36 lands, all 18 true-vote support and all 13 villainous-choice sources.
